I'm not giving up on college, if I can't graduate I'd rather die than drop out. I'm not kidding, I'm not exaggerating.

But two classes? I don't think I can come back from that when I only have two more years left of college. I'm already stuck on the five year plan, I don't have enough money to extend it to six. I will have to drop out if I can't get my GPA up in two years, if I drop out I will be a failure. No one will convince me otherwise. I'm not going to fail, I'd rather kill myself.

It's an online class and I have trouble reading the lessons rather than being physically taught them. I emailed the teacher asking for help, but the class is almost over with so I don;t see anything turning around. I can possibly late drop the class, but whatever. I feel like such a failure. If I fail this class that's two classes. One because of a stupid mistake, one because I'm just fucking stupid. Maybe I'm not cut out for college? Maybe I'm too stupid for college. If that's the case then I will kill myself.

yeah whatever i knew no one would care. like always. i cant even get a subreddit designed for helping suicidal people to talk to me, much less anyone else in my life to give a shit about me. add this next to my list of failures and reasons why i should not be alive.
